title: Model document (model.json)
description: The file model.json of a Live2D model's product (live2d.model): the objects of its object table the player reads, by object id, and facts about the model. See docs/data-format.md.

name.description: The model's id: the last part of its key.

prefab.description: The model's root GameObject; its json is the hierarchy (prefab.json).

moc.description: The CubismMoc MonoBehaviour; the moc3 is its file blob:_bytes.

textures.description: The atlas pages (Texture2D) the drawables draw with, by name.

shaders.description: Unity shader name -> Shader object: the shaders of the drawables' materials and the Cubism mask materials.

resources.description: The Material objects the Cubism mask pass draws with (Resources/Live2D/Cubism/Materials).

motionSync.description: The prefab's root has a CubismMotionSyncController with a Live2DMotionSyncCriAudioInput.

bindings.description: AnimationClip object -> per binding of the clip, the path below the model's root ("" for the root) and the attribute it animates; both null where the hierarchy names no single one (pathCandidates: the paths that fit).

objectId.description: An object of the product's object table: <serialized file>:<path id>.
